title: papaver rhoeas var. roubiaei
intro: Papaver rhoeas var. roubiaei, commonly known as Red Poppy, is a plant species in the poppy family known for its vibrant red flowers. The health benefits of Papaver rhoeas var. roubiaei include its antispasmodic and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of this plant include sedative and antispasmodic effects, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as alkaloids and flavonoids. Additionally, the bioactive constituents of Papaver rhoeas var. roubiaei, including papaverine and thebaine, have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial properties.
